comment: Independent artifact.c Mb_hit() cancellation of a shapeshifter. A debug-mode Wizard wishes for Magicbane, wields it, sets her experience level to 14 and creates a hostile chameleon, then fights it to the south. When the blade cancels it, zap.c cancel_monst() calls mon.c normal_shape(), and newcham() turns the fog cloud back into a chameleon.
